summary_rationale: Price-blind forensic audit confirms an extraordinary full-stack computing compounder: revenue scaled 31x over the past decade from $6.91B (FY17) to $215.94B (FY26) and reached $115.8B in Q3 FY27 alone (+103% YoY), with FY26 ROIC of 74.23%, 71.1% GAAP gross margin (74.8% in Q3 FY27), $102.72B operating cash flow, $96.68B free cash flow, and $53.5B in cash and marketable debt securities (plus $44.2B in marketable equity securities) against ~$7.5B long-term debt. CUDA, NVLink 6, Mellanox/Spectrum networking, and the rapid Vera Rubin NVL72 ramp (~$20B in its debut quarter) form a formidable architectural moat. However, kpi_health is rated PASS_WITH_WATCH due to four material operational risks: (1) the abrupt Nov 12, 2026 resignation of co-founder CEO Jensen Huang over personal conduct violations, leaving CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO during a permanent successor search; (2) off-balance-sheet supply commitments surging to ~$390B ($203B due in FY28, largely multi-year HBM memory contracts) alongside rapid working-capital expansion ($81.03B AR, $39.72B inventory in Q3 FY27); (3) Q4 FY27 gross margin compression to a guided 71.0%-72.0% trough due to Rubin ramp and rising memory prices; and (4) 36% direct revenue concentration in two customers plus hyperscaler custom ASIC substitution and zero China Data Center compute revenue under tightened U.S. export controls.
